_about: Recurring funder schemes without a machine-readable feed. The daily job re-reads each page and asks Claude to refresh the round dates. Add or remove entries freely. "sector": "industry" marks money from industry or industry-led bodies, and schemes run with industry; they appear under the Industry-led filter on Funding.

schemes.title: University Research Fellowship
schemes.note: Annual; opens mid-July, closes early-to-mid September (2027 round: 14 Jul - 9 Sep 2026); interviews in April, results in May

schemes.title: International Exchanges
schemes.note: Several rounds a year, each open about eight weeks: in 2026, Round 2 ran 9 Apr - 4 Jun and Round 3 ran 30 Jul - 24 Sep (15:00 UK time)

schemes.title: Industry Fellowship
schemes.note: Two rounds a year: opens early February and closes around 31 March/1 April; opens late July and closes mid-September

schemes.title: Short Industry Fellowship
schemes.note: Two rounds a year: opens early April and closes late May; opens mid-August and closes early October

schemes.title: Newton International Fellowships
schemes.note: Annual; the next round opens 13 January 2027 and closes 10 March 2027; results by 23 August 2027

schemes.title: Research Grants
schemes.note: Annual; opens late January, closes late March; decisions in August

schemes.title: ISPF International Collaboration Awards
schemes.note: Country-specific calls; the current call (Brazil and South Africa) is open 13 October - 3 December 2026, and results have been reported in each financial year since 2023/24

schemes.title: Research Fellowships
schemes.note: Annual, one round a year; Expression of Interest opens in May and closes in late June; invited full applications due in December; interviews the following May

schemes.title: Green Future Fellowships
schemes.note: Annual call; Expressions of Interest close in mid-November; stage-1 outcome in late March; assessment day the following October

schemes.title: Research Project Grants
schemes.note: Two-stage; outline applications accepted at any time (reopened 21 September 2026 on the new grant system); invited detailed applications follow

schemes.title: Philip Leverhulme Prizes
schemes.note: Annual; the 2026 round closed on 14 May 2026 with decisions in November; subjects rotate on a three-year cycle

schemes.title: Research Fellowships
schemes.note: Annual; the latest round closed on 5 November 2026 (4pm) for fellowships starting between 1 June 2027 and 1 May 2028

schemes.title: Early Career Fellowships
schemes.note: Annual; opens at the start of January, closes in the third week of February (4pm); decisions in May

schemes.title: Future Leaders Fellowships
schemes.note: Annual; opens early February, closes mid-June (round 10: 3 Feb - 18 Jun 2025; round 11: 2 Feb - 16 Jun 2026); sift the following March, interviews in May

schemes.title: ERC Starting Grant
schemes.note: Annual; the call opens in July with a deadline in mid-October (ERC-2026-StG: 9 Jul - 14 Oct 2025; ERC-2027-StG: 22 Jul - 14 Oct 2026); step-1 results the following May, final results in August

schemes.title: Marie Sklodowska-Curie Postdoctoral Fellowships 2027
schemes.note: Annual; the call launches in early April and closes in the second week of September; results the following February

schemes.title: Small Grants Programme 2026
schemes.note: Appears annual: the 2026 programme was announced on 14 October 2026 and closes on 14 December 2026

schemes.title: Grant funding (invited applications and themed calls)
schemes.note: No fixed cycle: most funding is directed or by invitation; open competitive calls are announced on the Calls for funding page

schemes.title: Supergen ORE Hub Flexible Funding
schemes.note: Irregular calls: April 2019, March 2020, April 2021, July 2023 and July 2024, plus a sixth call that is now closed

schemes.title: Supergen ORE Hub Early Career Researcher (ECR) Research Fund
schemes.note: Roughly yearly with gaps: calls dated October 2019, October 2020, March 2021, October 2021, March 2022, July 2023, October 2024, September 2025 and Call 8, which closed at noon on 9 November 2026

schemes.title: Forecasting Tipping Points Phase 2: full proposals
ARIA opportunity seeds
schemes.note: Irregular: seed calls are issued per opportunity space (past deadlines in April, June and August 2024, February and April 2025, February and July 2026)

schemes.title: ICE Research and Development Enabling Fund
schemes.note: Application window 1 November - 30 December 2026 with results by the end of February 2027; the page says updates on any further reopening will follow (older wording on the page said there were no deadlines)

schemes.title: ONR Global research grants, Visiting Scientists Program and Collaborative Science Program
schemes.funder: US Office of Naval Research Global
schemes.note: Rolling: proposals are submitted under ONR's Long Range Broad Agency Announcement (the current one, N0001425SB001, was published 1 October 2024 and accepts full proposals until 31 December 2026, 11:59 PM EST)

schemes.title: 1851 Research Fellowships
schemes.funder: Royal Commission for the Exhibition of 1851
schemes.note: Annual; the 2027 round closes at midday on 20 January 2027; shortlist by mid-March, interviews in May, fellowships start on 1 October

schemes.title: ISPF Research Collaboration Grants
schemes.note: Occasional calls for specific partner countries; the third call opened 2 June 2025 (expression of interest by 30 June 2025, full application by 4 August 2025)

schemes.title: Daiwa Foundation Awards and Small Grants
schemes.note: Two deadlines a year: 31 March (decision by end of May) and 30 September (decision by end of November)

schemes.title: Pushing the frontiers of environmental research
schemes.note: Open with no closing date since 23 September 2026; NERC aims to give a decision within nine months of submission

schemes.title: EPSRC standard research grant (responsive mode)
schemes.funder: Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council (UKRI)
schemes.note: Always open; applications are batched and sent to quarterly responsive-mode panels (Engineering, ICT, Mathematical Sciences, Physical Sciences)
